comment: The self-hosted embedding models the Kudos pilot compares (genki issue 92). Each gets an embedding server (embed_server.py) on `server`, its own platform and knowledge databases, its own API on `api`, a dataset digdir/kudos-next-<key> and a service kudos-pilot-<key>-retrieve-only. `prompts` are the model's own query/document prompts from its config_sentence_transformers.json; genki puts them before each text. `dtype` and `batch` are the server's; `maxBatch` keeps one embedding call under ~25 s on an M3 Pro.
